from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re,subprocess,datetime
root=Path.cwd()
plan=Path('docs/optimization/2026-11-plan')
prep=Path('docs/optimization/2026-11-use-feedback')
errors=[]
def check(ok,message):
 if not ok:errors.append(message)
def sha(data):return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def read(path):return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
base=read(prep/'baseline.json')
check(subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()==base['head_commit'],'HEAD changed')
for row in base['files']:check(sha(Path(row['path']).read_bytes())==row['worktree_sha256'],'Baseline worktree changed: '+row['path'])
decisions=read(plan/'decisions.json');objects=read(prep/'mechanisms.json')['objects'];limits=read(prep/'limits.json')['entries']
for label,actual,expected in [('objects',decisions['objects'],objects),('budgets',decisions['resource_decisions'],limits)]:
 check(len(actual)==len({r['id'] for r in actual})==len(expected),label+' duplicate/count mismatch')
 check({r['id'] for r in actual}=={r['id'] for r in expected},label+' IDs mismatch')
 for row in actual:
  check(bool(row['rationale']) and bool(row['action']),label+' missing rationale')
  check(set(row['work_packages'])<=set(f'W{i:02}' for i in range(1,9)),label+' invalid work package')
  check(set(row['acceptance_refs'])<=set(f'V{i:02}' for i in range(1,25)),label+' invalid case')
sources=read(plan/'sources.json');check(sha((plan/sources['base_catalog']).read_bytes())==sources['base_catalog_sha256'],'Base source catalog drift')
all_sources=read(prep/'sources.json')['sources']+sources['additional']
source_ids={r['id'] for r in all_sources}
check(len(source_ids)==len(all_sources)==42,'Source ID mismatch')
for row in all_sources:
 check(sha(Path(row['local_snapshot']).read_bytes())==row['sha256'],'Source identity mismatch '+row['id'])
for row in decisions['objects']:check(set(row['authority_refs'])<=source_ids,'Unknown authority '+row['id'])
probe=read(plan/'component-probe.json')
check(sha(probe['program'].encode())==probe['program_sha256'],'Embedded probe program identity mismatch')
check(sha(Path('.evaluation/optimization-design/20261102/component_probe.py').read_bytes())==probe['program_sha256'],'Local probe identity mismatch')
check(probe['exit_code']==0,'Component probe failed')
check(probe['result']['scope'].startswith('Component plumbing only'),'Probe scope overclaim')
check(sha((plan/'design.md').read_bytes())=='0f4b50ad0c99a46122c99e1b6d5e4a5bdfc0111d7e76e84331a9b16ca254c9e8','Independent checked design identity drift')
for path in list(plan.glob('*.md'))+list(Path('docs/audit').rglob('*.md')):
 text=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
 check(not re.search(r'许愿|孩子|傻子|愿望|\bwish(?:es|ing)?\b',text,re.I),'Public terminology '+str(path))
 check(all(line==line.rstrip() for line in text.splitlines()),'Trailing whitespace '+str(path))
(plan/'plan-check.json').write_text('{"status":"checking"}\n',encoding='utf-8')
prior=subprocess.run(['python','-B','.evaluation/optimization-preparation/20261102/check.py'],capture_output=True,text=True)
check(prior.returncode==0,'Preparation and global document structure check: '+prior.stdout+prior.stderr)
prepresult=json.loads(prior.stdout) if prior.returncode==0 else None
check(subprocess.run(['git','diff','--check'],capture_output=True).returncode==0,'git diff whitespace check')
program=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
result={'format':1,'checked_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':'Plan mechanical integrity, source/program identities, full disposition coverage and unchanged existing project files; not semantic conformance or implementation acceptance','counts':{'baseline_files':len(base['files']),'objects':len(objects),'budgets':len(limits),'primary_sources':len(all_sources)},'preparation_and_document_structure':prepresult,'component_probe_record_identity_verified':True,'independent_design_sha256':sha((plan/'design.md').read_bytes()),'product_source_configuration_locks_unchanged':not any(e.startswith('Baseline worktree changed:') for e in errors),'program_sha256':sha(program.encode()),'program':program,'errors':errors,'passed':not errors}
(plan/'plan-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['program','preparation_and_document_structure']},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if not errors else 1)
